recordingPrompt: Cluster the values found in this codebase and report the proposals you would make.

cases.note: The plan's own case: one brand blue written two ways is one token with a merge note, not two tokens.
A pixel apart in the same role is the same intent. The most-used member represents it — never an average nobody wrote.
Clustering converges what is nearly the same; it must not flatten what is genuinely different.
A 12px radius and an 8px padding are different facts. Roles are clustered separately, so these never merge.

A codebase with no stylesheet and no markup at all. The values pass is language-agnostic (v0.2.0 §5.1), so a JSON theme file and a Kotlin object cluster exactly as a `.css` file would — and the Go constant named `BrandBlue` is deliberately not read, because a name the project chose is not a property.
`radii: { card }` in JSON and `CardRadius` in Go are the same corner radius. The property name is what survives translation, so one decision comes out of two languages.
Widening the scan must not widen what merges: a 16px spacing and an 18px radius are still different facts in a theme file.
